en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a cemetery path running between rock formations and grave plots. On the left, graves and religious statues are carved into a cliff face with an iron fence and stone balustrade. On the right, numerous gravestones and crosses stand among dense trees. In the background there is a stone wall or ruin with an arched opening. Decorative cursive text is printed in the lower margin.
